_note: One Piper arm. Units: joints rad, gripper m. Limits are the spec sheet's, with J2 >= 0 and J3 <= 0 as the firmware accepts them. ik_guard reads joint_lower/upper, max_step_delta and control_hz; arm_tool.py reads the rest.
_ready: ready: a pose off the joint limits to start teleop from (deg J1..J6). J1 -93.3 faces the table on our rig; set yours.
_park: park: fold with the base held (J2 0, J3 0, J5 36.8 deg), turn the base to home_base_deg, damped e-stop, wait, disable.
_tool: arm_tool.py (make ready / park): firmware speed cap, percent
